claims.statement: Tom Allen and Tom Kelly arranged with Bill Richards an athletic and sparring tournament at the Union grounds on July 4, 1884.
claims.excerpt:
Messrs. Tom Allen and Tom
Kelly by which an athletic and sparring tour

claims.statement: Tom Allen and Tom Kelly were to spar the wind-up of the tournament, with the winner to receive a silver cup.
claims.excerpt:
In the wind-up between Allon
and Kelly the winner is to recetve a beautiful
silvercup

claims.statement: Entries for the Fourth of July events could be made at Allen's, among other places, after noon on June 25, 1884.
claims.excerpt:
Entries to the different events can be made
after noon to-day at Kelley's, Allen's,

notes: Sparring exhibitions only, not fights. Allen's entry point is not stated to be his saloon.
